result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals in a mixed-use area. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the apartment building

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the street without a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow traffic and increase pedestrian visibility, especially appropriate for this school zone.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a clearly marked zebra crosswalk and wide, well-maintained sidewalks in a residential area. However, the crossing is uncontrolled, lacking stop signs, traffic signals, or pedestrian-activated warning devices to manage vehicle speeds and yielding.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any regulatory control such as a stop sign or signal, placing the burden of safety on driver yielding behavior.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signage
hazards.description: There are no warning signs indicating a pedestrian crossing to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to sidewalk level to physically slow traffic and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing a baseline level of safety. However, visibility is compromised by parked cars near the crossing, and the lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increases pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash and debris are piled on the sidewalk near the corner, narrowing the accessible path.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility of pedestrians to oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks on both sides of the street. While basic infrastructure is present, the crossing distance is relatively wide without a median refuge, and the bike lane lacks physical protection.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway, including travel lanes and a bike lane, without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main road

hazards.name: Lack of bike lane protection
hazards.description: The bike lane is only paint-buffered, offering no physical protection from motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add physical separation to the existing bike lane to prevent vehicle encroachment and improve safety for all road users.
